label: EU AI Act High-Risk System Compliance
description: Governs AI agent operations classified as high-risk under the EU AI Act (Regulation 2024/1689, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744). Enforces risk management, data governance, transparency, human oversight, and technical documentation requirements per Articles 6-15 and Annex III.

controls.description: Estimate and evaluate risks from intended use and foreseeable misuse

policy_rules.reason: Art.9: critical-risk actions require human approval

controls.description: Design for sufficient transparency for deployers

policy_rules.reason: Art.13: all decisions must be explainable and logged

controls.description: Human oversight measures built in or identified
Humans can understand capabilities and limitations
Humans can decide not to use or override

policy_rules.reason: Art.14: high-impact actions require human oversight

controls.description: Technical documentation drawn up before market placement

policy_rules.reason: Art.11: AI system must have technical documentation (AI-BOM)

legal_basis: Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 (Digital Omnibus on AI), adopted 2026-07-08, in force 2026-07-27
enforcement_dates_provenance.change_note: Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 deferred application of Chapter III Sections 1-3 for Annex III high-risk systems from 2026-08-02 to 2027-12-02, and for Annex I high-risk systems from 2027-08-02 to 2028-08-02. Article 50 transparency obligations were NOT deferred and apply from 2026-08-02. The v1 key `high_risk_full` is replaced by `high_risk_annex_iii` because there are two distinct high-risk dates.
